title: Build bounded cumulative retry schedules
instruction: Complete build_retry_schedule(start_ms, deadline_ms, delays_ms) as a deterministic cumulative retry planner. Times are non-negative exact integers no greater than signed 64-bit max, start must not exceed deadline, and delays_ms is a list of positive exact integers. Validate every delay before calculation. Starting at start_ms, add delays cumulatively and return each retry time that is at or before the inclusive deadline; stop permanently at the first retry beyond it. Detect signed-64-bit addition overflow even if the overflowing retry would be beyond the deadline. Return a fresh list and never mutate inputs. Add tests and no dependencies.

author_metadata.notes: Wave-4 temporal lineage with cumulative delay semantics, inclusive deadlines, prevalidation, and overflow.
